description: This file defines a script to rename a field in the 'Sales Invoice' doctype within the ERPNext system, specifically adding support for Saudi Arabia E-Invoicing QR code functionality. It checks for certain conditions such as the existence of the 'Company' with country 'Saudi Arabia', the 'Sales Invoice' doctype, and relevant database columns, then creates or renames fields accordingly.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function to check preconditions, optionally reload the 'sales_invoice' doctype, create the custom field, and rename the 'qr_code' field to 'ksa_einv_qr' when applicable.
